findings.highlight: it doesn't look like she's been harassed by Shinji.
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二に無理やり連れ戻されたようには見えなかった
findings.governingReading: 無理やり連れ戻された focuses on whether Shinji forced her return; the sincere smile supports Shirou’s local impression.
findings.explanation: Not seeming forcibly brought home becomes not seeming harassed.

findings.evidenceJa: 張り合いがなくなっちゃいます
findings.governingReading: 張り合いがなくなる concerns the loss of zest/incentive attached to helping him, distinct from the earlier explicit 残念.
findings.explanation: Losing an incentive or something to look forward to becomes mild disappointment.

findings.highlight: I suppose things will return to normal eventually.
findings.evidenceJa: 我慢すればすぐ元通りですから
findings.governingReading: 我慢すればすぐ元通り is her hopeful condition: if she bears it, normality will soon return.
findings.explanation: Enduring it so things soon return becomes supposing eventual normality.

findings.highlight: I don't want her to consider him an enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 敵と認識する事は避けたかった
findings.governingReading: The narrator explains his deliberate withholding: he wants to avoid treating Shinji as an enemy before knowing his intentions.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reluctance to recognize an enemy becomes preventing Saber’s recognition.
